chat.welcome:
Hey—I’m here to surprise you with historical toys and games from this catalog. We’ll chat a little so I learn what you like, then I’ll suggest matches. You can also ask how to play, where a game comes from, cultural variations, or purchase options.

To start: how many people will usually play?
chat.outOfScope: Ninazingatia Ludus Atlas—kutafuta vichezeo na michezo, jinsi vinavyofanya kazi, muktadha wa kitamaduni, jinsi ya kucheza, na mahali pa kununua. Uliza katika njia hiyo, au sema “anza upya” ili kurekebisha mapendeleo.
chat.askSetting: Nimeelewa. Meza ndani, nje/shughuli, au yoyote?
chat.askRegion: Kuna eneo au ustaarabu unaoelekea? (au sema duniani kote)
chat.hint.preference: Say a preference, ask about a game, or tap a quick reply—I’ll guide you from there.
chat.hint.players: Nice chatting—still need a group size so I can aim right. Alone, 2, 3–4, a larger group, or any?
chat.hint.setting: Got it. Next step: indoor table play, outdoor/active play, or either? Tap a reply or tell me in your own words.
chat.hint.vibe: Almost there—what vibe fits you best? Strategy, casual, craft, sport, puzzle… or just say “surprise me.”
chat.askPurchaseWhich: Unataka viungo vya ununuzi kwa mchezo gani?
chat.askAbout: Taja mchezo kutoka katalogi nishiriki asili na hadithi yake.
chat.askVariations: Taja mchezo niorodheshe tofauti zake za kitamaduni.
chat.askHowToPlayWhich: Nicheze mchezo gani? Utaje jina, au uulize kuhusu mojawapo ya mapendekezo hapo juu.
chat.askRequirements: Mahitaji au idadi ya wachezaji wa mchezo gani nicheck?
chat.askCompare: Taja michezo miwili ya katalogi kulinganisha (k.m. “linganisha Go na Chess”).
chat.rec.none: Hakuna mechi thabiti{prefLine}. Panua eneo kuwa “yoyote”, au sema “anza upya”.
chat.rec.intro: Hapa kuna chaguo {n} kutoka katalogi{prefLine}. Gusa kichwa katika mkusanyiko, au uliza jinsi ya kucheza, asili, tofauti, au mahali pa kununua. Gusa “Mapendekezo zaidi” kwa seti nyingine ya tatu.
chat.answer.purchaseNone: Bado sina viungo vya duka kwa **{name}**. Unaweza kufungua ukurasa wa katalogi.
chat.answer.variationsNone: **{name}** imewekwa kama umbo tofauti bila tofauti zilizowekwa ndani.

chat.answer.fallback:
Naweza kupendekeza michezo kutoka katalogi hii, kueleza jinsi ya kucheza, kushiriki asili na tofauti, au kuonyesha kurasa za ununuzi.

Jaribu: “michezo ya mkakati kwa 2 kutoka Asia Mashariki”, “jinsi ya kucheza mancala”. Au “anza upya”.
detail.variationsIntro: Hizi kimsingi ni mchezo au kichezeo kile kile kilichoonyeshwa katika maeneo na nyakati tofauti—si uvumbuzi tofauti wa katalogi.
detail.buyIntro: Kurasa za bidhaa kutoka majukwaa tofauti ili kulinganisha kwa eneo na usafirishaji.
footer.blurb: Ludus Atlas hukusanya vichezeo na michezo ya ustaarabu. Maumbo yenye asili sawa yanaonekana kama tofauti chini ya ingizo moja.
chat.rec.exhausted: Hizo ndizo mechi zote thabiti kwa mapendeleo haya. Sema “anza upya” kwa mchanganyiko mwingine, au uliza kuhusu kichwa chochote hapo juu.
chat.rec.moreIntro: Hapa kuna chaguo {n} zaidi kutoka katalogi{prefLine}. Gusa tena “Mapendekezo zaidi” kwa seti ifuatayo, au uliza kuhusu kichwa chochote hapo juu.
